# UpneX Solutions

> UpneX builds AI employees for property management companies — software that plugs into a PM's existing stack (AppFolio, Buildium, Rent Manager, Rentvine, DoorLoop, and others) to handle maintenance coordination, leasing, tenant support, and back-office work. No platform migration; no new software for the team to learn.

## What UpneX does
- AI Maintenance Coordinator: receives requests, creates work orders, dispatches vendors, and keeps tenants updated end-to-end, 24/7.
- AI Leasing Assistant: responds to inquiries in seconds, qualifies leads, books showings, and follows up automatically.
- AI Tenant Support: answers common tenant questions, sends rent reminders, and looks up lease info around the clock.
- AI Back Office Assistant: handles documents, data entry, reports, and follow-ups.
- Each AI employee is built for the specific PM company's portfolio, voice, and existing tools — not a generic template.

## Who it's for
Property management companies of any size running AppFolio, Buildium, Rent Manager, Rentvine, DoorLoop, Innago, Yardi Breeze, Propertyware, TenantCloud, Hemlane, or any platform with an API or email integration.

## Pricing
Per-unit pricing based on portfolio size and scope; contact via https://upnexs.com/book/ for a quote.
